experience.title: Research Analyst
facts: Designed mixed-methods studies on public-service access and synthesized findings for policy and nonprofit stakeholders.
Conducted interviews, coded qualitative themes, and analyzed survey results in R.
Wrote research reports and presented actionable recommendations in stakeholder workshops.
Maintained consent, anonymization, and research-documentation practices for participant data.

experience.title: Research Assistant
facts: Supported literature reviews, survey administration, and descriptive statistical analysis for community research projects.
Prepared tables, charts, and briefing materials for academic and public-sector audiences.
